summary: First-finish smoke test of ERP Cargo.Ops MVP. Backend auth, RBAC, exchange fallback, dashboard stats and CRUD across Compras/Importação/Estoque/Financeiro/Agenda all return 200 with expected fields. Frontend login → dashboard → sidebar navigation across 19 modules → DataView 'Novo' modal creates a Pedido successfully (toast 'Registro criado' + row visible) → Administração lists users → logout returns to /login. USD/BRL ticker renders (values dashed due to AwesomeAPI unreachable from sandbox, which is expected fallback).
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin credentials → 200 with user payload + Set-Cookie access_token & refresh_token
GET /api/auth/me with valid cookie → 200; without cookie → 401
POST /api/auth/logout → 200 + Set-Cookie Max-Age=0 clearing both tokens
GET /api/exchange/usd-brl → 200 with bid/ask/pctChange fields (fallback values, expected)
GET /api/dashboard/stats → 200 with pedidos_total, aprovacoes_pendentes, produtos_total, containers_ativos, processos_ativos
GET /api/users as admin → 200; as non-admin (comprador) → 403 'Sem permissão'
Frontend /login page renders and accepts admin@erp.com/admin123, redirects to /

Sidebar shows all 19 nav-* modules (dashboard, pedidos, sugestoes, aprovacoes, processos, containers, portos, navios, proformas, produtos, depositos, movimentacoes, adiantamentos, saldo, numerario, cambio, agenda, relatorios, administracao)
DataView 'Novo' opens modal, fields (field-numero, field-fornecedor, ...) work, modal-save creates record and it appears in the table with success toast
Administração page accessible to admin, lists admin@erp.com
topbar-logout logs out and returns to /login
notes: AwesomeAPI 'unavailable' fallback on /api/exchange/usd-brl is expected per problem statement. Recommend full testing agent verify all module CRUDs (only Compras Pedidos verified via UI; other modules verified only via API POST) and edit/delete UI paths.
